top_categories.workout_context: 114 Gravel Race's portuguese rolling gravel rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
114 Gravel Race's Portuguese rolling, European gravel forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 85 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic 114 Gravel Race's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before March.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of 114 Gravel Race. Train it until it feels boring.
At mile 60 of 85, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
At 114 Gravel Race, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
When someone attacks on portuguese rolling gravel, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At 114 Gravel Race, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 85 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 3,386ft of climbing on portuguese rolling gravel does to your power file on race day.
Varied gradients on portuguese rolling gravel demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on portuguese rolling gravel. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for 114 Gravel Race’s 85 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at 114 Gravel Race requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on portuguese rolling gravel to build confidence. Expect: portuguese rolling, european gravel, regional event.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Gravel Specific, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 85 miles of portuguese rolling gravel in Portugal.
